name: com.excellentcalendar.cloud.admin
comment: Internal operations, audit, feature controls and dead-letter recovery. Planned: it is never exposed through the public user API by default.

comment: Provider-neutral asynchronous extraction that produces candidates only. Planned: accepted candidates must enter through the calendar application API.

name: com.excellentcalendar.cloud.backup
comment: Backup snapshots, restore, import and export orchestration. Planned: backup is explicitly separate from synchronization.

name: com.excellentcalendar.cloud.boot
comment: Process-role selection and Spring application assembly. Business rules do not belong here.

comment: Scheduler process assembly point. Scheduled jobs must use database claims or leases.

comment: Worker process assembly point. Consumers are added only together with a durable queue contract.

name: com.excellentcalendar.cloud.calendar
comment: Cloud representations of approved calendar entities and ownership rules. Planned: it must not replace the offline C++ Core.

name: com.excellentcalendar.cloud.datedmessage
comment: Dated messages and future sharing visibility rules. Planned: visibility, recipient and moderation rules remain undecided.

name: com.excellentcalendar.cloud.holiday
comment: Public calendar feeds, holiday occurrences and user feed subscriptions. Planned: the data model and public Contract still require approval.

name: com.excellentcalendar.cloud.identity

Public interface for sending email messages.

The initial implementation uses MailDev for local development. Production implementations should use SendGrid, AWS SES, or similar.

methods.comment: Computes SHA-256 hex digest.

methods.comment: Masks an email for display, e.g. "u***@example.com".

Password hashing using Argon2id.

The default parameters are safe for development. In production, benchmark against the target hardware to tune the salt length, hash length, parallelism, memory, and iterations.

methods.comment: Encodes a raw password.

methods.comment: Verifies a raw password against an encoded hash.
